name: @pipeworx/mcp-boston-calendar

tools.name: events
tools.description: Upcoming Greater Boston events from The Boston Calendar. Defaults to a 2-week window from today. Filter by date range, keyword (title/description/tags), and free admission. Returns normalized events sorted by date/time.

to.description: Latest event date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 14 days from `from`). Pass "" for no upper bound.

query.description: Keyword filter over title, description, and tags, e.g. "free music", "kids", "art".

free_only.description: If true, only events whose admission is free.

tools.name: tags
tools.description: List the event tags/keywords in use on The Boston Calendar, with counts — useful as filterable facets for the events tool.

limit.description: How many top tags to return (default 40).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-boston-calendar forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the boston-calendar pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
